[F002] ## Summary

Implemented F002 (dashboard project-selection CLI) for plan `2026-05-23-005-feat-dashboard-project-selector-v0`. Extended `projects_dashboard.py` with `UnknownProjectError`, `ResolvedSelection`, `resolve_selection`, `find_cwd_project_entry`, `build_selected`, and `mirror_selection_into_state_dir`; added `--project <name>|all` to `dashboard build/open/serve` argparse subcommands and routed all three through `build_selected` (current-repo fallback when registry is empty, focused-project build with stub fleet entries for the rest, or full fleet build). The serve watcher fingerprint now includes `~/.dontpanic/projects.json`, so `dontpanic projects add <name>` mid-serve refreshes the fleet summary without a manual restart, and a project that disappears from the registry degrades to the default selection rather than crashing. Wrote `test_projects_dashboard_cli_f002.py` covering 24 cases across all seven acceptance items (defaults for zero/one/cwd-match/multi-project, explicit `--project`, unknown-name fail-loud at both library and CLI layers, registry refresh during `serve`, no-Firebase imports, loopback-only default, and `--help` plumbing) — all 24 pass, plus the 98 existing F001 + dashboard CLI + registry regression tests stay green. Flipped F002 to `passes: true` in `features.json` with evidence refs pointing at the changed sources and the new test file.
